name: wait-secret
description: After a Claude Code turn ends, flags lines in the files that turn changed that look like a secret: a short count on the status line, then a masked list. Local regex only. Never blocks or edits a file.

enabled.title: Flag likely secrets a turn wrote
enabled.description: On by default. When a turn ends having added lines that look like a key or token, a status-line count and a masked list. Only a warning: nothing is blocked, edited or uploaded. Off leaves every turn silent.
